data.text:
**predict_admet_properties** — Comprehensive ADMET profiling, hERG cardiac safety, and Lipinski rule-of-five compliance screening for small-molecule drugs.

- **Input:** Three compounds as SMILES strings:
  - Caffeine: `CN1C=NC2=C1C(=O)N(C(=O)N2C)C`
  - Aspirin: `CC(=O)OC1=CC=CC=C1C(=O)O`
  - Terfenadine: `CC(C)(C)c1ccc(cc1)C(O)CCCN2CCC(CC2)C(O)(c3ccccc3)c4ccccc4`

- **Key steps:**
  - **RDKit molecular property calculation** → MW, LogP, HBA, HBD, rotatable bonds, TPSA per compound
  - **hERG IC₅₀ prediction (XGBoost classifier)** → cardiac liability ranking (GREEN/YELLOW/RED)
  - **ADMET panel scoring** (6 endpoints: hERG, DILI hepatotoxicity, Caco-2 permeability, BBB penetration, aqueous solubility, Ames mutagenicity) → risk flags per compound

- **Expected output:**
  - `admet_results.csv` — per-compound ADMET scores, hERG classification, Lipinski compliance (Pass/Fail), physicochemical properties
  - `risk_summary.json` — aggregated safety profile, GREEN/YELLOW/RED per endpoint, hERG margin (IC₅₀/Cmax)
  - Lipinski violations flagged (MW >500, LogP >5, HBA >10, HBD >5)

**Note:** Terfenadine is a known hERG inhibitor (historical cardiac liability). The workflow will flag this as expected for your QA validation.

workflow_ga.name: Predict ADMET Properties (AI)
workflow_ga.description: AI-powered ADMET prediction using Chemprop graph neural networks (ADMET-AI, Swanson et al. J Chem Inf Model 2023). Trained on 2M+ experimental measurements from ChEMBL and TDC. Covers 15 endpoints: Caco-2 permeability, CYP1A2/2C9/2C19/2D6/3A4 inhibition, hERG cardiotoxicity, BBB penetration, aqueous solubility, plasma protein binding (PPBR), volume of distribution (VDss), half-life, LD50, lipophilicity. Preferred for all new ADMET screening. Use ADMET Pred (Legacy) only for backward compatibility.
